current_prompt.body:
FIND all exact covers of the universe U = {1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9} using the collection of nine 3‑element sets S1..S9.
IMPLEMENT the search with Algorithm X employing dancing links.
PROVIDE a self‑contained test that verifies each solution covers every element of U exactly once and that no element appears in more than one selected set.

current_plan.body:
PARSE the definition of universe U and the collection of sets S1..S9
INITIALIZE the dancing‑links data structure for Algorithm X representing the exact‑cover matrix
EXECUTE Algorithm X to enumerate all exact‑cover selections of sets
FOR each discovered exact‑cover solution
VERIFY that the union of the selected sets equals U
VERIFY that no element of U appears in more than one selected set
ENDFOR
GENERATE a self‑contained test that iterates over all emitted solutions and asserts the two verification conditions for each
